title: Declarative InitPhase operator and tenant-scoped hook templating for connector seed manifests
author: Ava Lin
merge_commit: squash: introduce InitPhase operator and hook template helpers; update values shim and docs
description:
Motivation: past upgrades surfaced brittle imperative init jobs and tightly coupled Helm hooks that made tenant bootstrap ordering difficult to reason about in air-gapped/on-prem installs. This change introduces a lightweight declarative InitPhase operator CRD plus Helm template helpers and a values shim that produce tenant-scoped connector seed manifests and sequenced hook resources. The goal is to decouple sequencing intent from imperative job orchestration so installs and upgrades are more auditable and resumable.

What this PR does (single-line narrative): adds an InitPhase CRD and controller-friendly annotation conventions, extends helm templates with 'initPhase' helper functions, supplies a values translation shim (values.v1beta->values.v1alpha) for backwards compatibility, and wires the installer charts to emit phase-scoped seed manifests instead of inlined init Jobs for connectors.

Key changes and rationale: - InitPhase CRD: a small CRD that declares ordered phases, optional timeout, and capacity hints. Operators or the private-installer can act on these phases rather than relying on Helm hook ordering. This reduces failure modes during partial upgrades and allows external controllers to resume work when Helm aborts. - Helm helper templates: new templates/chart_helpers/init_phase.tpl and templates/tenant-seed-phase.yaml.tpl that render Phase objects and connector seed manifests scoped to a tenant. These helpers accept values.* v2-style phase definitions and retain compatibility with legacy initJobs via the shim. - Values shim: values/translate_v1beta_to_v1alpha.go (generator) and a helm values example values/tenant-init-phases.example.yaml. The shim converts common legacy initJobs blocks into the declarative phases at chart render time for existing customers. - Templating changes avoid large inline job manifests; seed manifests are generated as separate files under templates/seed-manifests/ so we can apply them via the InitPhase operator or keep older behaviour when the feature flag is disabled. - Canary rollout support: a feature gate values.privateInstaller.enableInitOperator (false by default). When enabled, chart emits InitPhase objects; when disabled it falls back to legacy init Jobs. This allows staged rollouts per-tenant.

Checklist: - [x] CRD schema and OpenAPI v3 validation added - [x] Helm helpers with unit tests - [x] Values shim CLI check (generator tested locally) - [x] E2E in k3s harness for 2 tenants (canary + default) - [x] Migration docs and upgrade notes included - [x] CI green after fixups

Testing and verification: - Unit: chart template unit tests for helper functions and schema linting were added (tests/helm/helpers_test.go) and run in CI. - Integration: a k3s-based integration (infra/tests/k3s_init_operator/) was run that validates: phase ordering respected, connector seeds applied, and partial failures correctly resumable by re-applying phase objects. - Manual: ran full private-installer airgap install in staging (tenant-a canary, tenant-b default). Verified audit logs contain InitPhase lifecycle events.

Rollout plan: Merge gated behind feature flag. Initial rollout to staging, enable enableInitOperator for 5% of new tenant installs and monitor installer-phase-duration metric. If stable for 72h, widen to 25%, then enable by default in next minor. Backout: set enableInitOperator=false and helm upgrade to re-emit legacy jobs; the values shim will preserve previous job definitions.

Related: ENG-2145 (init-phase operator design), SUP-4412 (customer incident describing broken tenant bootstrap), design doc: docs/design/init-phase-operator.md (internal), helm example: values/tenant-init-phases.example.yaml.

review_comments: Diego Park (2026-02-13): request changes - CRD should explicitly set the 'preserveUnknownFields: false' and add a shortName 'ip' for ergonomics. Also please add example status with phase progression in the CRD YAML to help QA.
Ava Lin (2026-02-13): replied - added preserveUnknownFields and shortName; included status example and updated tests to assert status propagation.

Tomás Ruiz (2026-02-17): approve - unit + integration looks good; e2e failures earlier fixed by tightening template escaping; recommend monitoring init_phase.duration metric after rollout.
ci_checks: e2e (flaky): first run failed on template escaping, rerun passed
testing_notes: Integration harness uses K3s with two tenants. Tests validate ordering and idempotency by creating a simulated failure on phase-2 and ensuring re-apply resumes from phase-2. Unit tests exercise helper templates and the values shim generation. Local airgap test performed by building the private-installer tarball and applying CRDs before rendering charts.
migration_steps: 1) If you rely on legacy initJobs, set values.privateInstaller.enableInitOperator=false during the upgrade to preserve behavior. 2) To opt-in, enable the feature flag and run helm upgrade; the chart will emit InitPhase objects and seed manifests. 3) Monitor metric installer.init_phase.duration and installer.seed.apply_errors for regressions. 4) To rollback, set enableInitOperator=false and helm upgrade to re-emit jobs; apply the legacy job manifests if they were previously pruned.
release_notes: Add optional InitPhase CRD and templating that allows declarative sequencing of tenant bootstrap phases. Default behaviour unchanged; opt-in via values.privateInstaller.enableInitOperator. Includes a values translation shim for backwards compatibility and example tenant values.
